acceptance: Reproduce the existing fail-closed closeout blocker where a genuine Orchestrator task_reassigned audit event uses supervisor-task-reassigned-<digest> while the verifier currently accepts only supervisor-reassign-<digest>.

Change only the bounded event-id compatibility predicate so both canonical prefixes are accepted when and only when the digest over the event payload matches exactly; retain the Orchestrator actor, task identity, owner/reviewer fields, timestamp parsing, chain continuity, ordering, archive integrity, and all fail-closed behavior.

Add focused positive tests for both canonical prefixes and negative tests for wrong digest, wrong prefix, forged actor, missing fields, cross-task event, and ambiguous chain; run the complete relevant ai_status test suite.
Record exact-head evidence and a task-scoped manifest before independent review; preserve existing audit/state data and do not add a manual reconciliation bypass.

Keep this task source-only: no live runtime mutation, no supervisor restart or signal, no canonical task-state edit outside governed commands, no provider/account change, and no rollout retry. Delivery requires clean branch, commit, PR, independent review, checks, and protected merge.
task_spec.summary: The approved temporary rescue removed an uncommitted runtime-only compatibility diff after preserving it. Deliver the same narrow fix through the governed source flow so reassigned-task closeout and worker dispatch can recognize existing canonical event IDs without weakening verification.
task_spec.title: Accept canonical supervisor task-reassigned event-id prefixes without weakening audit verification
